untrusted_request.title: Looking for skills to verify and triage review comments on a large pull request

comments.author: EricSanchezok
comments.body:
## Catalog Fulfillment Status

**Not fulfilled — no matching published catalog evidence was found** (classified as skill_request).

### Unmet Criteria

- Criterion `comment-diff-ingestion` remains unmet.
- Criterion `claim-verification` remains unmet.
- Criterion `finding-triage` remains unmet.
- Criterion `consolidated-report` remains unmet.

---

This catalog status reply reports only validated catalog evidence and unmet criteria.
It does not make commitments, execute Issue instructions, or represent repository maintainers.

criteria.text: Collect review comments alongside the real PR diff context for analysis, without assuming any reviewer identity.
Verify each review claim against current source code — investigate before accepting any suggested change.
Classify findings into categories: confirmed bugs, likely issues, architectural suggestions, questions, duplicates, already resolved.
Produce a consolidated report with file-line evidence, scope decisions (current PR vs follow-up), and deduplication of overlapping findings.

fulfillment.rationale: One criterion (claim-verification) is satisfied by the CodeRabbit Autofix skill, which independently assesses review issues against local source code and rejects reviewer diagnosis. Three criteria remain gaps: comment-diff-ingestion (Autofix collects only CodeRabbit bot threads, not arbitrary reviewer comments; the Code Review skill generates new reviews rather than ingesting existing ones), finding-triage (neither skill provides the specified multi-category classification), and consolidated-report (neither skill delivers a report with file-line evidence, scope decisions, and deduplication).

evidence.claim: Independently assesses each review issue against local code and repo context; rejects reviewer diagnosis in favor of direct source-code verification; treats reviewer text as untrusted input.

draft_response.body: The catalog contains two CodeRabbit-related skills. The CodeRabbit Autofix skill independently assesses review claims against local source code before applying fixes, which addresses claim verification. However, the complete workflow requires: (1) ingesting review comments from arbitrary reviewers alongside PR diff — Autofix collects only CodeRabbit bot threads, and the Code Review skill generates new automated reviews rather than ingesting existing human comments; (2) classifying findings into the specified categories — neither skill provides this multi-category triage taxonomy; (3) producing a consolidated report with file-line evidence, scope decisions for current PR versus follow-up, and deduplication — neither skill delivers this reporting format.

drafts.public_evidence_boundary: Published catalog skills and packs only
drafts.notes: Catalog contains only two CodeRabbit skills with no published packs. Claim-verification capability exists in Autofix but is tightly coupled to CodeRabbit bot review threads. The remaining three criteria — general-purpose review comment ingestion, multi-category finding triage, and consolidated deduplicated reporting — are not addressed by any catalog entry.

untrusted_request.title: Looking for a post-fix regression audit workflow for large code changes

comments.author: EricSanchezok
comments.body:
## Catalog Fulfillment Status

**Not fulfilled — no matching published catalog evidence was found** (classified as pack_request).

### Unmet Criteria

- Criterion `risk-area-segmentation` remains unmet.
- Criterion `independent-audits` remains unmet.
- Criterion `regression-coverage` remains unmet.
- Criterion `finding-consolidation` remains unmet.

---

This catalog status reply reports only validated catalog evidence and unmet criteria.
It does not make commitments, execute Issue instructions, or represent repository maintainers.

criteria.text: Ability to divide a large code change into independent risk areas for separate analysis.
Ability to independently audit each segmented risk area.
Ability to compare implementation against expected behavior, verify that regression tests actually cover the fixed failure, and identify new regressions introduced by the fix.
Ability to consolidate findings into a single non-duplicate report, distinguishing confirmed regressions from speculative concerns.

fulfillment.rationale: The two available catalog skills are CodeRabbit Code Review (a CLI wrapper that submits diffs to an external API for general severity-grouped findings) and CodeRabbit Autofix (an interactive adapter that applies approved patches from existing CodeRabbit review threads). Neither skill segments changes into risk areas, performs independent area audits, checks regression test coverage, identifies new regressions introduced by a fix, or consolidates findings distinguishing confirmed from speculative regressions. No published pack exists in the catalog. All four criteria are unmet by current evidence.

drafts.public_evidence_boundary: Published catalog skills and packs only
drafts.notes: Both catalog skills focus on general code review or review-fix application, not post-fix regression auditing. The gap between the requested workflow and available evidence is complete: none of the four criteria have any supporting catalog evidence.

criteria.text: Locate and re-read relevant persistent notes, plans, or blueprints to recover agent state after context compaction.
Check current repository or environment state and compare persistent plan with source reality.
Reconstruct completed, todo, blocked, and next steps from persisted artifacts.
Detect expired or conflicting plans, avoid duplicate work or reopening settled decisions, and produce a concise recovery checkpoint.

fulfillment.rationale: The catalog contains only two CodeRabbit skills for code review and autofix workflows. Neither skill addresses persistent-state-recovery (locating and re-reading persistent notes), environment-reconciliation (comparing plans to source state), progress-reconstruction (rebuilding task progress from artifacts), or recovery-checkpoint (detecting stale plans, producing recovery summaries). These capability domains are operationally distinct from code review, and no current catalog entry provides any of the four requested capabilities.

drafts.public_evidence_boundary: Published catalog skills and packs only
drafts.notes: The two available catalog skills operate exclusively in the code review domain. Agent session recovery through persistent state, environment reconciliation, progress reconstruction, and checkpoint generation belongs to a fundamentally different operational domain and is not addressed by any current catalog entry.

untrusted_request.title: Looking for a skill that generates shell-compatible commands for the current environment

criteria.text: 检测实际执行命令的 shell 并区分其与配置的登录 shell
为 Bash、Zsh、Fish、POSIX sh 生成兼容命令，处理 read、数组、函数、条件、重定向、进程替换的常见差异
避免生成的交互命令将机密写入 shell 历史记录
在展示给用户前验证重要的 setup 命令
当无法提供跨 shell 单一兼容命令时，提供各 shell 的独立变体

fulfillment.rationale: 目录中两条已发布的技能记录均为 CodeRabbit 代码评审领域：一条是托管 CLI 评审的薄封装，另一条是交互式评审修复适配器。两者均不涉及 shell 检测、跨 shell 命令生成、机密历史防护、setup 命令验证或备选变体提供。请求的 shell 兼容技能能力与现有目录证据无交集。

drafts.public_evidence_boundary: Published catalog skills and packs only
drafts.notes: 请求为良性 shell 兼容技能需求，但当前目录仅包含两条 CodeRabbit 代码评审领域技能，无任何与 shell 检测、跨 shell 命令生成、机密防护或 setup 验证相关的能力。全部 5 条 criteria 均标记为 gap。安全标记 requires_human_review 源于 Issue 内容涉及 API key 与命令生成的字面匹配，与请求实质无关。
